about: Scene tint and dusk (issue #523): prontera's ground and buildings stay as they are in daylight (white diffuse, tint 1). @night fades them over about 1.7 s to tint thousandths 775, 750, 1000 (#C6BFFF) while units keep their colours; @day fades back. mag_dun01 is not nightenabled, so @night leaves it, and its ground and models are multiplied by its own tint. The formula, the dusk steps and the blind rule are checked by unit tests.
